d:
Sardi ki taazi matar se banayein khasta Matar Puri jo gubbare jaisi phoolti hai Masala Kitchen
Ek hi matar masale se Matar Puri aur Matar Paratha, na phatega, na filling ek taraf rahegi.
Matar ki puri: bahar se crispy, andar se soft
Matar ka paratha: har taraf bhari hui filling
Matar phatne se rokne ki chhoti trick
Ek matar peethi, do recipes
Chai, achaar ya dahi ke saath garma garam serve karein. Sardiyon ke nashte aur tiffin, dono ke liye perfect.
Comment karein: aap puri banayenge ya paratha?
